title: Bari Bari no Mi
structure: 3 techniques + Barrier Bulls as the peak (no stages and no awakening)
facts: Appearance: not revealed (plain swirl fruit stands in)
Paramecia, Barrier-Barrier Fruit: see-through barriers that are nearly unbreakable
Withstood Oden's slashes (Semimaru), Elizabello's King Punch and Dellinger's kicks
Barrier stairs to climb into the air; Barrier Ball to trap people inside
Barrier Bulls: charging forward behind a barrier to plow through enemies
Only one barrier at a time (couldn't fully block Pica's stone fist)
Users: Bartolomeo (Luffy's superfan); before him, Kurozumi Semimaru of Wano

plan.fruit: The fruit's appearance **has never been revealed**, so a plain round swirl fruit in light blue stands in (no face or limbs). (Fan wikis disagree on a look; none is canon.)
cast: **Bartolomeo:** tall green crest of hair, sharp teeth, piercings, open dark coat. Send a reference to match him exactly.
**Semimaru:** shown only as a faded old Wano scroll portrait (no reliable look found).
plan.sets: ice rink, mint rays, crystal cave, glass office lobby, glass-dome arena, rope bridge over a canyon, sheer cliff, playground, sunny bullring, city at night, rubble-strewn town, superfan bedroom with posters, old Wano hall with a scroll, rainy meadow.
